en.r: Everglades National Park is a national park in Florida, United States. It covers 5,670 km² and has been protected since 1947. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: The Calusa and Tequesta lived here, later the Seminole and Miccosukee. Drainage for farming threatened the "river of grass", and journalist Marjory Stoneman Douglas fought for it. The park was created on 6 December 1947 and is a World Heritage Site, biosphere reserve and Ramsar site.
en.ff: It protects the southern Everglades: flooded sawgrass, mangroves, cypress and Florida Bay. It is the only place where American alligators and American crocodiles live side by side; there are manatees, Florida panthers and huge wading bird colonies.
